title: Bioluminescent Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a young person with pale skin and dark hair, looking directly at the viewer. Their face, neck, and shoulders are covered in numerous glowing, translucent spheres in shades of green, pink, purple, and blue, with faint golden mathematical symbols visible across the lower portion.
prompt: close-up portrait of a young person with pale skin against a solid black background, face and shoulders covered in clusters of translucent glowing spheres in vibrant green, pink, magenta, and purple, some spheres floating away from the body, subtle golden mathematical symbols and equations faintly visible across the neck and chest, soft dramatic lighting, realistic skin texture with surreal elements, moody and atmospheric
